name: Unrestricted-Rank Tope-Graph Classes Are Polynomial-Time Recognizable
statement: From an arbitrary graph, membership in each unrestricted-rank tope-graph class associated with a COM, an oriented matroid, an affine oriented matroid, or a lopsided system can be decided in polynomial time.
proof: First recognize a partial cube and recover its $\Theta$-coordinates. The intrinsic characterizations then reduce membership to polynomially many gating tests on antipodal and, in the affine case, conformal subgraphs. The method handles the infinite obstruction families directly and does not enumerate them.
